Install a host package in a running VM.

Copies the package into a new folder in the guest, runs /usr/sbin/installer as root with the startup volume as the target, and then removes the copy. Pomme waits up to 1800 seconds (30 minutes) for the installer unless you pass `--timeout`, at most 86400 seconds. If the wait ends first, the installer keeps running in the guest and Pomme leaves the copy in place.

```text
pomme install [NAME] --pkg PATH [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--pkg PATH` | Host path of a flat installer package (.pkg) to install. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
